about: Zones and passability of people and pets for house.agent_moved and house.confined (VERIFY_HARDENING 6.4, critique hole 20; WP1). zone(p): p's baseline room plus, for a pet, the rooms holding its food, water, litter and bed (entities whose category or type is listed under pet_needs, owned by p or by nobody), and, for a person, their bedroom (home_room), a bathroom (the nearest room of a bathroom type) and an exterior exit (a room reached through an exterior door or an outdoor room) unless the person is a child under exit_min_age or carries a wandering flag. reach(p, S): rooms reachable from p's room over connections passable to p: a connection without a door; an open door (open, or open_frac >= open_min); a pet door for a pet (pet_door_types); stairs unless p is flagged unable (stairs_unable_flags or abilities.mobility in stairs_unable_mobility); a locked door only for a keyholder (a person with authority >= keyholder_authority who is not a child). A pet inside a crate or carrier (crated true, or its location an entity) reaches nothing.
